misc: Rarely uses his driver, which has raised questions about his masculinity.
biography: Ossi emerges as a fascinating and unconventional tactician within the storied annals of the Hector Trophée, bringing his refined golfing talents from the immaculate fairways of Kullo Golf Club to the esteemed pair competition across four distinct editions. Known among his companions for a fiercely independent mindset on the links, this thoughtful competitor approaches every round with an unwavering tactical discipline that completely defies conventional wisdom.

Among his peers, Ossi is particularly legendary for his steadfast refusal to pull his driver from the bag, a conservative strategy that frequently raises bewildered questions among adversaries regarding his competitive bravado and perceived masculinity. Yet, rather than yielding to peer pressure, he calmly continues to carve up courses using shorter irons and fairway woods with surgical precision. While victories of the coveted Hector Trophée and the individual acclaim of the Victor Trophy have thus far eluded his grasp across his four tournament appearances, his active participation in the vibrant community surrounding the event ensures that his captivating journey remains fully open, leaving admirers in eager anticipation of his next masterclass on the course.
